games.name: Tower FL
games.desc:
Tower FL is a tower obby with randomly generated stages. There are no checkpoints! Can you race other players to the top?

Win coins for every stage you finish. Use your coins to open boxes in the shop and see how many cool cosmetics you can get, Can you collect them all?

VIP server owners can use the settings menu to skip rounds, change the tower size, and lock the shop and commands in chat here:
/skip to skip tower
/setlength (number of stages 4-200) to set how many stages you want
/lock or /unlock to lock the shop

games.desc:
